instructions.title: Pilot
steps: Choose the ship's lane and call out where cover is needed.
Ask Engineer for enough output before an evasive maneuver.

instructions.title: Engineer
steps: Balance engine output against heat and the crew's power needs.
Use coolant when needed and tell Shields when power is tight.

instructions.title: Shields
steps: Point protection toward the danger and watch shield energy.
Coordinate power with Engineer and announce which side is covered.
